privacy:
{{name}} (“we”) runs {{domain}}. This page explains what we collect through this site and why. We follow India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 and, for visitors in the UK and EU, the GDPR.

## What we collect

What you type into our forms or the chat assistant (name, company, email, phone, budget range and message), the page you sent it from, your browser's time zone and, if present, the campaign tags in the link you arrived from. If analytics is switched on, anonymised usage data.

## Why

To reply to you, prepare anything you asked for (such as an audit) and understand which pages are useful. Form submissions and contact details shared in the chat go straight into our own CRM. We never sell personal data.

## The chat assistant

Chat messages are stored with the conversation so a specialist can follow up. To write its replies, the assistant sends the conversation to our AI provider, which processes it on our behalf. Please don't share passwords, payment details or other sensitive information in the chat.

## Job applications

When you apply for a job we keep what you send (your details, CV, links and note) so the people hiring can review it and contact you. Only our hiring team can open CVs, and we use your application only for recruitment: for the role you applied for and, with your agreement, similar roles later. Ask us at any time to delete it.

## What stays in your browser

We remember how you first arrived (in your browser's local storage) so an enquiry carries its source, and keep an open chat for the rest of your visit. No advertising cookies are set by this site.

## Your choices

Email [{{email}}](mailto:{{email}}) to see, correct or delete what we hold about you. We'll do it within 30 days.
